stratagems.when: Your Charge phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a charge move.
stratagems.fx: Each enemy unit engaged with your unit makes a battle-shock roll, with -1 to that **battle-shock roll**.

stratagems.when: End of the Fight phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged Orks Infantry unit that was eligible to fight this phase and is wholly within 6" of a friendly Transport unit that INFANTRY unit is able to embark within.
stratagems.fx: Your INFANTRY unit embarks within that TRANSPORT unit.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Wagon unit ends a normal move.
stratagems.fx: Units embarked within your unit can make an assault disembark move.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged Beast Snagga unit that lost a wound as a result of those attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a surge move of up to D6". If your unit is riled up, it can re-roll that D6.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit is riled up until the start of your next turn.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Walker unit (excluding Titanic units).
stratagems.fx:
When a model in your unit is destroyed, if your unit has not been selected to fight this phase, roll one D6, with +3 to the result if your unit has Deff Dread:

• On a 4+, do not remove that model from the battlefield. When your unit has fought, or at the end of the phase (whichever comes first), that model is removed from the battlefield.

stratagems.when: Your Movement/Charge phase, when a friendly Orks Walker unit is selected to move or declares a charge.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has MOBILE.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft unit is destroyed, before rolling for any Deadly Demise.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit does not have the **Deadly Demise** ability. Select one enemy unit within 12" of your unit and roll eight D6:

• For each 4+, that enemy unit suffers 1 mortal wound.Then remove your unit from the battlefield.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Aircraft/Deffkoptas unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx: When your unit’s ranged attacks target a FLY unit, those attacks can re-roll hit rolls.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged Deffkoptas unit within 8" of that enemy unit.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

• Up to D6".
• Or: If your unit is riled up, up to 6".

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Beast Snagga Boyz/Boyz unit is selected to move.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has +2 to advance rolls.

stratagems.when: Start of the Battle-shock step of your Command phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly Orks Infantry unit of 13+ models.
stratagems.fx: Select one visible friendly ORKS unit within 12" of your unit. That unit’s battle-shock rolls are automatically successful.

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Boyz unit that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s melee attacks have +1 **A**.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase.
stratagems.fx: Select any number of friendly Orks Infantry units within 3" of your unit. Each selected unit heals 3 wounds.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Mek Gunz unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

• [Lethal Hits].
• Or: [Sustained Hits 1].
• Or: [Hazardous], [Lethal Hits], [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit targets a friendly Orks Infantry unit (excluding Gretchin units).
stratagems.tg: One friendly Gretchin unit within 3" of that ORKS INFANTRY unit.
stratagems.fx: When a hit roll for that enemy unit’s ranged attacks that target that ORKS unit results in a hit, if a model in your GRETCHIN unit is on the battlefield, end the attack sequence for that attack and your GRETCHIN unit suffers 1 mortal wound.

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Movement phase, when an enemy unit ends a move within 8" of a friendly unengaged Gretchin unit.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit can make a normal move of:

• Up to D6".
• Or: Up to 6" instead if your unit is an attached unit.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when an enemy unit has attacked.
stratagems.tg: One friendly Gretchin unit that was just destroyed. You can target that unit with this **stratagem** even though that unit was just **destroyed**.
stratagems.fx: Add a new GRETCHIN unit to your army identical to your **destroyed** unit, in strategic reserves, at its starting strength, with its full wounds remaining.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s ranged attacks have [Sustained Hits 1].

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit (excluding MONSTER/VEHICLE units) have +1 to wound rolls.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Infantry unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s ranged attacks that target a unit within 9" have +1 **AP**.

stratagems.when: End of your opponent’s Movement phase.
stratagems.tg: One friendly unengaged Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit that was **engaged** at the start of the phase.
stratagems.fx: Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6".

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Boyz/Kommandos/Stormboyz unit is selected to make an advance/fall-back move.
stratagems.fx: That move does not prevent your unit from being eligible to start an action.

stratagems.when: Start/end of your Movement phase.
stratagems.fx: Select one objective your unit is controlling. That **objective** is secured.

stratagems.when: Your Movement phase, when a friendly Orks mounted/vehicle unit is selected to move.
stratagems.fx: Your unit has +2" **M**.

stratagems.when: Any phase, when a friendly attached Orks Infantry unit becomes battle-shocked.
stratagems.tg: That ORKS INFANTRY unit. You can target that unit with this **stratagem** even though it is **battle-shocked**.
stratagems.fx:
Roll one D3:

• Your unit suffers a number of mortal wounds equal to the result.
• Your unit is no longer **battle-shocked**.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s ranged attacks have:

• [Rapid Fire 1].
• Or: If that attack already has [RAPID FIRE], +1 to the value of that [RAPID FIRE] (e.g. [RAPID FIRE 1] becomes [RAPID FIRE 2]).

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly Orks Vehicle unit (excluding Walker units) that made a charge move this turn is selected to fight.
stratagems.fx:
Your unit’s melee attacks have:

• [Cleave 1].
• Or: If that attack already has [CLEAVE], +1 to the value of that [CLEAVE] (e.g. [CLEAVE 1] becomes [CLEAVE 2]).

stratagems.when: Fight phase, when a friendly ORKS unit is selected to fight.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s melee attacks have [Lethal Hits].

stratagems.when: Your opponent’s Shooting phase, when an enemy unit has shot.
stratagems.tg: One friendly Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit hit by those attacks.
stratagems.fx: Your unit shoots using normal shooting, but while doing so your unit can only target that enemy unit.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly unengaged Breaka Boyz/Flash Gitz/Tankbustas unit has shot.
stratagems.fx:
• Your unit can make a normal move of up to 6", and must end that move within range of an objective.
• Your unit is not eligible to declare a charge until the end of the turn.

stratagems.when: Your Shooting phase, when a friendly Orks Transport unit is selected to shoot.
stratagems.fx: Your unit’s ranged attacks with weapons selected for the Firing Deck ability have +1 to hit rolls.

frules.d:
Friendly ORKS units with this ability can:

• Re-roll **advance rolls.**
• Become **riled up**, as stated in other rules.
While a unit is **riled up**:

• That unit has 5+ **InSv**.
• That unit’s ranged attacks have [ASSAULT].
• When that unit is selected to make an **advance move**, that **advance move** does not prevent that unit from being **eligible to declare a charge**.**War Cry (Once per battle, per army):** At the start of the Command phase, you can use this ability. If you do, friendly ORKS units with the **Waaagh!** ability are **riled up** until the end of the next turn.
At the start of the battle round, if a model with this ability is your WARLORD, gain 1CP.

Orks Psyker units with this ability have a **psyker level** of 1 or higher, specified in that unit’s abilities. Each **psychic ability** has a **psychic level** of 1 or higher, specified in that ability’s name.

In a battle round, a friendly ORKS PSYKER unit can use a number of **psychic abilities** whose total **psychic level** does not exceed that PSYKER unit’s **psyker level**.

**Example:** In a battle round, a **psyker level 3** PSYKER unit could use three **psychic level 1**abilities, or one **psychic level 1** ability and one **psychic level 2** ability, or one **psychic level 3** ability.

The following are special move types that certain or all of your units are eligible to make.

	PULSE JET MOVE
	

	
		
		
		**MAXIMUM DISTANCE:** Pulse roll + 18"**ELIGIBLE IF:** As stated in the rule allowing this ****move type****.
**EFFECT:** Your unit moves as described in Moving (Core Rules, 03).
**BEFORE MOVING:**

• Make a **pulse roll** by rolling one D6.**WHILE MOVING:**

• Ignore all vertical distance for the purposes of how far your unit has moved.
• Your unit can move through all types of model.
• Your unit can move horizontally and vertically through all categories of ****terrain feature****.**AFTER MOVING:**

• Your unit must be ****unengaged****.
• Until the end of the turn, your unit is not ****eligible to declare a charge**** or ****start an action****.
• Until the start of your next turn, attacks that target your unit have -1 to ****hit rolls****.
	
	

	ASSAULT DISEMBARK MOVE18.06
	

	
		
		
		**SET-UP DISTANCE:** 3"**ELIGIBLE IF:**

• Embarked within a TRANSPORT on the battlefield
• Did not embark within that TRANSPORT this phase
• That TRANSPORT has not made an **advance**/**fall-back move** this phase**EFFECT:** Set up as described in Set Up (03.02).
**WHILE MOVING:** Set up each model wholly within the **set-up distance** of that TRANSPORT.
